maddeler.e:
نتمايز (form VI)
# نَتَمَايَزُ (natamāyazu) /na.ta.maː.ja.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# نَتَمَايَزَ (natamāyaza) /na.ta.maː.ja.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
# نَتَمَايَزْ (natamāyaz) /na.ta.maː.jaz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَايَزَ (tamāyaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
